s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision decline with a posterior segment mass
salient_findings: Declining vision in the left eye
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye
Large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
key_facts: 20-year-old woman
Monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years
Best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
Nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident in the left eye
Mass had grown considerably in size since the last visit
Ophthalmoscopic examination showed a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology was negative for malignant cells
Microscopic findings showed a hypovascular myxoid lesion
Immunohistochemical studies showed positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision decline with a posterior segment mass
salient_findings: Declining vision in the left eye
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye
Large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
key_facts: 20-year-old woman
Monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years
Best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
Nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident in the left eye
Mass had grown considerably in size since the last visit
Ophthalmoscopic examination showed a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology was negative for malignant cells
Microscopic findings showed a hypovascular myxoid lesion
Immunohistochemical studies showed positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

differentials: Malignant melanoma of the ciliary body
Metastatic carcinoma to the ciliary body
per_call: Malignant melanoma of the ciliary body
Metastatic carcinoma to the ciliary body

shortlist.label: Medulloepithelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Posterior segment mass with growth and vision decline

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 and glial fibrillary acidic protein immunohistochemical studies

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypovascular myxoid lesion with positive S100 immunohistochemical study

shortlist.label: Neurilemoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to schwannoma, with positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

shortlist.label: Leiomyoma of the ciliary body
shortlist.why_kept: Hypovascular myxoid lesion, although less likely given negative smooth muscle actin

raw.rationale: The presence of a large white mass emanating from the nasal ciliary body, the growth of the mass over time, and the microscopic findings of a hypovascular myxoid lesion with positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein are consistent with medulloepithelioma, a rare tumor of the ciliary body.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and clinical features typical of neurofibroma

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic Antoni A and Antoni B areas and S100 positivity is not exclusive to schwannoma

rejected.label: Neurilemoma
rejected.why: Similar to schwannoma, neurilemoma would typically show more pronounced S100 positivity and specific histological patterns not described here

rejected.label: Leiomyoma of the ciliary body
rejected.why: The microscopic and immunohistochemical findings do not support a smooth muscle origin, as smooth muscle actin was negative
